about:
SMR-Metal Technology operates from South Windsor, Connecticut, where it provides metal manufacturing and fabrication services. The company emphasizes that its parts are made entirely in the United States.

The shop offers a full range of fabrication capabilities, including CNC laser cutting, punching, bending, sanding, deburring, milling, MIG and TIG welding, and final assembly. It works with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, brass, and copper, and can apply powder-coat, paint, or plating finishes. The company accepts projects at any design stage, from sketches or samples through to finished parts.

Its customer base spans automotive, locomotive, aerospace, medical, energy, marine, defense, communications, restaurant customization, and original equipment manufacturing (OEM) sectors.
